title: Desktop Apps & skills: filters, saved skill metadata and provider entry controls
goal: Distinguish desktop local filters/navigation, current status/validation, organization skill metadata and composer insertion from actual provider grants, AI sends or approved actions.
prerequisites: Internal source-only draft; current installed support/service/access/connection state require separate current checks. Desktop view is not public marketing catalog.
Current owned desktop context/revision/workspace; owner/admin UI canManage differs from server authority. Paired server capability/catalog/storage checks may refuse a visible control.
Nested Slack/Teams/Linear/Outlook/cloud controls remain separately governed; genuine exact independent review required where their guides specify, never satisfied by opening panel.
permissions: Filter/status/catalog labels/skill names/tool disclosure do not grant provider/tool/AI execution authority. Installed provider can include needs-attention, not healthy-only.
Skill metadata is organization/workspace installation state plus audit, not grant to tools; UI error/rollback not storage rollback. Server workspace administrator rule remains decisive.
Use in Agent inserts draft only after current enabled skill/context checks, not Send. AI/provider actions require separate current constraints/explicit intent.
MCP topic leaves to public documentation service. Use public technical terms only; no private code/secrets/PII. Availability check not installed search entitlement.

steps.instruction: Open desktop Apps & skills, not public website /integrations. Bot-origin entry selects Apps and offers Back to Axiom Bot only while original context/revision/identity remains owned; other entry starts All.
steps.expectedState: App mounts PluginsSkillsView; canManage UI only owner/admin. Connection settings goes to Settings; Airflow Open goes to Batches. Navigation is not provider execution or consent.

steps.instruction: Refresh capabilities/Retry reloads skills, integration status and Airflow connection. Search apps and skills filters loaded names/details/categories locally; choose one All/Apps/Skills/Developer tools(MCP)/Installed/Enabled/Disabled filter.
steps.expectedState: Browse and Status are alternative values, not intersected groups. Installed skills status not not_installed; providers exclude not_connected/checking/unavailable, thus includes needs-attention states, not healthy-only. Enabled/Disabled hide provider rows. Empty matches are local filter outcome.

steps.instruction: Inspect current returned provider row and choose Connect/Configure/Manage/Open only when owned context/admin/config/status permit. Browser links must match supported configured HTTPS provider hosts.
steps.expectedState: Rows/catalog labels not proof every operation available. Service-unconfigured Connect disabled. Opening browser is not final consent/grant; server can refuse UI-offered control.

steps.instruction: Use Verify access only when appropriate, then inspect returned current validation/status and provider-specific guidance. For held Slack/Teams validation use Reload status/Review consent.
steps.expectedState: Validation may update saved connection state but is not message approval/health guarantee. Matching new receipt/pending rules clear hold, not every Refresh. Never replay unknown validation/token rotation simply to bypass hold.

steps.instruction: For revoked GitHub, inspect existing-installation account type/repository selection and unexpired challenge before Reconnect verified installation. Use Dismiss review or Reload GitHub status after uncertainty.
steps.expectedState: Confirmation sets reload hold before send. Dismiss local review is not provider installation removal; unconfirmed result needs status reload. Other connection options opens separate browser Connect, no actual installation/permission acceptance here.

steps.instruction: For returned connected Slack, Manage/Notification reviews opens nested controls; Teams/Linear Actions opens shared panel. Open Outlook appears only All/Apps when separate keyword matching passes.
steps.expectedState: Opening panels no human approval/actionauthority. Outlook can be hidden by Installed/Enabled/Disabled/MCP even while connected and loads its own status. Close does not revoke/undo. Nested provider controls use separate guides.

steps.instruction: Review skill tools expands local guidance/tool names. Add/Enable/Disable/Remove changes workspace installation metadata only when current canManage/storage/idle/server policy permits.
steps.expectedState: GET paired pipeline:read/noAPIkeys; POST additionallyworkspace admin/catalog validation. Add/enable upsertsenabled, disable existing row/remove installation; audit followsmutation. Audit failure can return503after metadata changed; no proven rollback.

steps.instruction: After unconfirmed skill change Refresh current state before another deliberate mutation. Use in Agent only for enabled skill/current storage/callback/idle.
steps.expectedState: App passes context/workspace selection; Agent rechecks current enabled skills and inserts composer draft, not Send/AI/tool authority. Failure/unknown leaves changes unavailable until fresh state; fallback curated catalog not installed.

steps.instruction: Under Developer tools(MCP), Check connection reads service availability even without installed enabled skill. Enter public Documentation topic then Search docs only when enabled/idle/nonempty.
steps.expectedState: Topic max300characters sent to Microsoft public docs; no secrets/private code/PII. Handler bounds2048byteJSON/rate/audit and pipeline:read. Check availability separate from installed search entitlement; not cloud scan.

steps.instruction: Open only returned safe result-title links; preserve current workspace/context during any pending action.
steps.expectedState: At most10HTTPSlearn.microsoft.com results. Unavailable/auditfailure not proof no public docsrequest occurred. Changing workspace/closing/abort cannot undo provider consent or dispatched work; stale responses not current authority.

expectedOutcome: Find applicable desktop control/filter and reconcile original current state without converting navigation/status/metadata/validation into grant, approval or execution evidence.
